title: Concept: Dynamic code evaluation via Eval.me (groovy) — review required
description: In groovy, Eval.me turns a string into running code. Evaluation sinks collapse the data/code boundary, so any untrusted bytes in the string become an injection primitive. The groovy-specific remedy is data-only handling via a typed builder or parser.
applicability: groovy codebases that build code or expressions from strings via Eval.me; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Code execution in the application process when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because evaluation sinks rarely constrain what the injected code can do.
